paragraphs: Abba Mari, brother of R. Yose, Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot 8, halakhah 9. R. Abba Mari is an amora. It seems to me that the Jerusalem Talmud calls R. Assi 'Yose' in several places. Many times it has R. Abba Mari; several times R. Ambari, meaning Abba Mari; likewise Avmari (see his entry).
